questions.question:
**Select the option that is related to the fifth number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the fourth number is related to the third number.**

17 ∶ 189 ∶∶ 13: 69 ∶∶ 18 ∶ ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **(1st number)² - 100 = 2nd number**.

Now,

For, 17 ∶ 189

→ 17² - 100

→ 289 - 100 = 189. 

For, 13: 169

→ 132 - 100

→ 169 - 100 = 69. 

Similarly, for **18 ∶ ? **

**→ 182 - 100**

**→ 324 - 100 = 224.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.

questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and Ill. Question ID: 264330143712 Status : Answered Chosen Option : 1 Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All males are boys.

Some teachers are boys.

All students are teachers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some boys are males.

II. Some teachers are students.

Ill. All males are students.

options.text: Only conclusions II and Ill follow
Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions I and Ill follow

questions.solution:
Statements:

All males are boys.

Some teachers are boys.

All students are teachers.

The Venn diagram as per the given statements:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/416ba43ff3d8726714021846c6b534925fdda7fe6caafb2ec8ae40e8320382a6.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some boys are males. → **Follow** (All males are boys, which means some boys are males also)

II. Some teachers are students. → **Follow** (All students are teachers, which means some teachers are students)

Ill. All males are students. → **not follow** (Because there is no definite relation given between males and students, it is possible but not definitely follow.)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusions I and II follow".**

Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

1664 ÷ 4 × 2 + 712 - 316 = 436
questions.solution:

Given:

⇒ 1664 ÷ 4 × 2 + 712 - 316 = 436

(1) **÷ and +**

⇒ 1664 ÷ 4 × 2 + 712 - 316 = 436

After changing the signs:

⇒ 1664 + 4 × __**2 ÷ 712**__ - 316 = 436

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 1664 + __**4 × 0.0028**__ - 316

⇒ 1664 + 0.0112 - 316

⇒ 1664.0112 - 316 = 1348.0112

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

questions.question: If exactly 1 year and 2 days later it is Tuesday, then what day is it today? It is not a leap year.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Normal year = 365 days = 52 weeks + 1 day

As per the question:

1 year and 2 days later is Tuesday, which means the last day of the year is Saturday.

In a normal year first and last days are the same means** today is also Saturday.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
